brief: 011 C: background plates for the HUD concepts, direction A (Glyph)
how: Unity Editor, Suborned.World.People.Plates (menu Suborned/World/People/HUD Plates (011)); Camera.Render into ARGBHalf (MSAA 1, the URP asset's), Graphics.Blit into ARGB32 sRGB, ReadPixels (Capture: Glint's honest path); GPU Resident Drawer off for the renders; no debug UI (IMGUI never reaches a Camera.Render)
coords: screen px at 1920x1080, origin top left, x right, y down; plan = metres in the plan frame (Unity x = plan x, Unity z = plan y)

peopleLayer.model: capsules in the job's colour block (people.json); people inside are not drawn (exteriors only); walkers on a straight line from the spot they stood on (the walk graph is not exported); background residents are counts, not drawn

casting.m2:
FAIL  M-2    Every role the mission names is cast from the city's people, there when needed, one pinned by id, and the cast can play it: waitress p-cafe-11, driver -, guard -, councillor - (all roles)
